title: Kinematics
subtitle: Kinematics with model-based reasoning, equations, and exam application.
concept: Kinematics describes motion without analyzing forces. The focus is on displacement, velocity, acceleration, and time relationships.
For uniformly accelerated motion, SUVAT equations provide a complete mathematical toolkit. Choosing the equation that omits the unknown variable simplifies problem solving.
Graph interpretation is equally important. Gradients and areas connect algebraic equations to visual motion analysis.
